statements.t: As in any competitive market, our ability to match or beat other contract manufacturers pricing for the same items may also alter our outlook and the ability to maintain or increase revenues.
We will continue to focus on our core businesses and push forward in maintaining our cost structure in line with our sales and expanding our customer base.
The total amount is expected to be funded from our Convertible Line of Credit Note, lease financing and cash provided from our operations.

estimates.t: There have been no changes to our critical accounting estimates in the three months ended September 30, 2026.

risks.t: changes in general economic and business conditions
loss of market share through competition
introduction of competing products by other companies
the timing of regulatory approval and the introduction of new products by INBP
pressure on prices from competition or from purchasers of INBP’s products
regulatory changes in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry and nutraceutical industry
regulatory obstacles to the introduction of new technologies or products that are important to INBP
the loss of any significant customers or suppliers
inflation, including inflationary pressures from any tariffs, and tightened labor markets
